name: Toyota technical with ZU-23-2
armament: ZU-23-2 twin 23 mm autocannon on the bed
protection: Unarmoured. Game rule still treats the vehicle body as immune to small-calibre, but 7.62x54R and up penetrate; occupants, glass and tyres are exposed to all fire. The 23 mm guns penetrate light armour and MRAPs (game proposal).
visual_notes: Hilux or Land Cruiser 79 pickup with a ZU-23-2 mount bolted in the bed, often with welded side plates
Gunner seated on the mount, long twin barrels over the cab
Ammo boxes on both sides of the mount
